title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2.6 Product Security and Bug Fix Update
description: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2.6 includes a security fix for an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Google Brotli decoder used by the python3.12-brotli package (CVE-2026-111497). This vulnerability could potentially lead to memory corruption. The update addresses this issue in the affected platform versions for RHEL 9 architectures.
